rationale: Cognate with ⲇⲱⲭⲃⲉ 'diminish' (in glossary) but with initial ⲃ rather than ⲇ. Likely a Lyc orthographic variant on the same root. Paired here with ϣⲧⲁ 'lack' as the doublet 'lack-and-diminishment' for the cosmic deficiency caused by Hyle's energeia.

Lyc reflex of Coptic ⲗⲓⲃⲉ 'be mad, rage' (Crum 140b). Paired here with ⲥⲕⲁⲛⲇⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉ 'stumble' as the cognitive-affective fall-pair of those subjected to the energeia of Hyle. Manichaean cosmological-anthropological term for the deranged state induced by matter dwelling within.

ⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲟⲩ = 'honor, dignity' (cf. ⲡⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲟ in accumulated vocabulary) + ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁⲕⲏ (Greek κυριακή 'Lord's Day' = Sunday, in glossary). Standard Manichaean ecclesiastical phrase for the special dignity/observance of Sunday — the day of the catechumens' fast and (per the question here) the earthly sign of a heavenly second-instance mystery.

Lyc reduced form: ⲧ̄- (the) + ⲧⲉ (= ϯⲟⲩ 'five') + ⲛ̄ϩⲃ̄ⲥⲱ ('garments'). Cf. parallel ⲡⲉϩⲧⲟⲩ 'the five' formations in vocab. The Five Garments = the Five Sons / Five Light Elements donned by the First Man as armor (= the Five Storehouses ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ in glossary). Standard Manichaean cosmological technical term.

Coptic transcription of Greek ἐπειδή 'since, because, inasmuch as' with Lyc orthographic ⲁⲏ for Greek ηδ. Standard discourse-marker introducing a justification clause; here in disciple's request 'persuade us about it, since [...].'
